items.quote: When King Jeroboam heard what the man of God cried out against the altar at Bethel, he stretched out his hand from the altar and said, “Seize him!”
items.contrast: King Jeroboam gives the order; the man of God is the person to be seized.
items.reason: The pronoun “him” refers to the man of God whose words prompted Jeroboam’s command. The question tests actor versus recipient, not merely recall of a name.
